messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered for service 'inference-api-prod' — escalation chain shows target: platform-oncall (rotation id: rot-42). Incident PDINC12345 — page fired at 2026-03-14T02:34:38Z
jamie (oncall_inference): Wait, i just got a page to platform-oncall? that's not my rota. did the paging rule change?
devon: I'm seeing the same in PD UI — service binding lists rot-91 (inference-oncall) *and* rot-42 (platform-oncall). looks like a duplicate binding.
maria: Confirmed. PD binding for inference-api-prod has two rotations. I'm removing rot-42 now.
jamie (oncall_inference): Handing off to @devon since platform already acked. jamie -> devon :wave:
platform-oncall: Ack by alex (platform) — will triage.
devon: Alex — can you confirm if you saw errors or customer-impacting failures? Telemetry shows a CPU spike on gpu-pool-3 and increased retry traffic around 02:30-02:37 UTC.
alex (platform): We saw a small spike, some requests fell back to secondary region and incurred tail latency. No 5xx reported. I'll check logs.
alice: Summary so far: PD routed to wrong rotation due to duplicate binding. Immediate mitigation steps: 1) remove rot-42 from PD binding (maria: in progress), 2) suppress noisy alerts, 3) route test alert to inference-oncall, 4) assess customer impact.
sre-bot: suppression applied via PD API by maria (action id: act-7745) — auto-retries disabled.
devon: Removal confirmed. Triggering a low-severity test alert to validate routing.
pagerduty-bot: Test alert routed to inference-oncall — pending ack.
jamie (oncall_inference): Acked the test. I have control again.
maria: Customer impact assessment: tenant 'acme-corp' saw increased tail latency for ~7 minutes (02:30–02:37 UTC). Estimated affected traffic: ~3% of production RT in that window. No user-facing errors reported, but higher retry/latency observed.
ops_lead: Good catch. Action items before postmortem: 1) revert any bad PD binding changes via terraform where possible; 2) add unit/integration test to catch duplicate rotation bindings; 3) add a monitor to detect overlapping schedule targets.
devon: I'll own the postmortem (PD routing + schedule-sync). Owner: devon, tech lead: alice. Draft ETA: 48h.
alice: Also adding a console warning rule: if a service has >1 active rotation binding for high-sev alerts, alert the oncall and config owner.
jamie (oncall_inference): Handoff log for records: jamie -> devon -> alex(ack) -> jamie resumed.
maria: Filed follow-up ticket RED-3456 "PD duplicate rotation binding causing misroute" and assigned to devon.
devon: Repro notes to include in postmortem: 1) schedule-sync job merged legacy rota 'platform-night' into new 'platform-oncall' without clearing legacy binding; 2) PD API upsert left both rotation ids on the service. Logs:
```
2026-03-14T02:30:15Z pd-sync INFO binding upsert service=inference-api-prod binds=[rot-91,rot-42]
2026-03-14T02:31:02Z pagerduty API response 200 OK
```

maria: Added a temporary watch rule: alert if binding_count(service) > 1 for 24h. Will follow-up if we see repeats.
ops_lead: Any customer comms needed? Support reports no incoming tickets about errors; if that changes, route to CS and notify execs.
devon: Will include suggested mitigations in the postmortem: add idempotent PD binding updates in syncer, validate expected single-binding invariants, and add a canary test after schedule changes.
alice: Also scheduling a short-runbook: if a PD misroute happens, steps: 1) check PD bindings, 2) suppress noisy alerts, 3) remove incorrect rotation, 4) run test alert, 5) assess customer impact, 6) open postmortem ticket. I'll add this to runbooks.
jamie (oncall_inference): Thanks all. Good coordination.
devon: Closing active work here — will post link to postmortem doc when ready. Thanks everyone :tada:
